study.question: Can removing coefficient rearrangement and weighted-value pooling workspace preserve the current global-contraction model while reducing measured prediction cost, without reducing learned capacity or changing training?
study.hypothesis: Observed: round69 global contraction changed click AUC only +0.00000150 (0.6675003891 to0.6675018907) and model p50 from15.3391 to14.5342ms, with unchanged31,993,779 parameters. Live-only work gave15.2051ms; combined14.3439ms. These are single-run timings without fixed-state diagnostics, not repeated speed evidence. Round67/68 item-ID12 reductions lost roughly0.00045-0.00051 AUC relative native96 and did not lower inference time; the ID16 linear control also slowed. Mechanism hypothesis: remaining evaluation tensor layout/copies and weighted-value materialization impose avoidable memory traffic. Direct summary-major stacking preserves the same global GEMM operand exactly; separate stratum BMMs remove the explicit Bx10x3xV weighted tensor, retaining all three nonlinear-weighted strata. Extra launches, strided input reads or FP32 GEMM overhead may erase savings. This is an execution-efficiency hypothesis with no new representation or originality claim.

nearest_work.difference: Immediate local nearest implementation. Read and hashed its available standalone module, including target summary, compression, scoring and pooling. New changes are prediction-only layout and pooling workspace; all model information, learned capacity and training are inherited.

Read archived primary DIN text lines56-120 via authorized source. Inherit target-conditioned local activation and Dice through the adapted joint model. This work does not introduce attention or grouped representations; it changes the execution of existing fixed summary/pool reductions.

Pinned primary benchmark implementation lines220-309 groups adjacent tokens, applies learned Q/K/V attention and an FFN. This proposal retains all incumbent event/statistic values and learned maps and only alters evaluation contractions. paper:longer resolves to link/provenance only; original author equivalence and priority remain unverified.

inherited_components: All31,793,216 embedding and200,563 dense parameters and complete global-parent configuration
Uniform/feedback compression and training seven-stratum normalization support; masks and unknown target action
Five target-match/position/block/quadratic/duplicate summaries and every support/norm gate
Shared scorer with source-specific gradient ownership; task residuals and reduced private heads; buy context factor rank96
Global summary BMM, merged query/history evaluation affine, Dice mixture factoring; no cache, new buffers or RNG
study.proposed_difference: Two independent prediction-only switches: evaluation_coefficient_layout=native|direct and evaluation_pool_reduction=materialize|contract. Direct stacks [centered,position,block,fourth,fifth] as[B,5,10,10] then reshapes[B,5,100], rather than stack[B,10,5,10], cast, transpose and copying reshape. Pool contract keeps the inherited weights*counts multiplication and promoted product dtype, then uses three BMMs of[B,1,10] by strided[B,10,V] outside autocast and concatenates[B,3,V]. No full weighted-value tensor is constructed; no persistent transformed weights/state. The unchanged weighted reduction executes throughout training. Control is a byte-identical copy of the available global parent, with its original configuration.
predictions: Direct-layout coefficient arrays and global BMM outputs should be bitwise equal at a shared state under deterministic execution, including BF16; a mismatch rejects this implementation before scoring.

Pooling retains every stratum and real-arithmetic weighted sum with FP32 operand promotion under the frozen BF16 path. Fixed-state FP32 absolute error must be <=1e-6+1e-4*max_abs_reference; measure and report BF16 per-task probability and pooled-tensor discrepancies rather than presuming equality.

Freeze quality criteria before host screening: full validation click AUC >=0.666553547526167 (entry0.666753547526167 minus0.0002) AND no more than0.0001 below contemporaneous global control. AUC increases alone are not the target, and neither single seed nor this threshold establishes statistical equivalence.

Freeze cost utility: candidate model p50 <=98% of fresh reference, model p95 <=101% and end-to-end validation inference seconds <=101% of reference, matched batch8192 and same runtime. Label an isolated passing run preliminary; require same-direction cost reduction on repeated matched complete units before repeated-support claims. Include casts, stack/cat, strided dispatch, all preparation and contraction overhead.

Parameters stay31,993,779; training state, gradients, RNG and optimizer step identical. No predicted training speed benefit. Explicit pool weighted workspace B*30*V is removed, but backend scratch and total peak memory must be measured; three launches may be slower.
falsifiers: Any initialization/state/gradient/optimizer or training-path difference, forbidden input use, missing retained stratum, or mutated evaluation buffer invalidates the implementation contrast.
Any deterministic direct-layout fixed-state output mismatch, incorrect event ordering or pool FP32 error beyond the frozen bound stops that cell for diagnosis.
Click AUC below either preservation bound, or absent measured prediction cost reduction, rejects utility of that candidate at this protocol.
A cost effect that disappears in repeated matched units does not support reproducible efficiency. A nonadditive combined result requires the factorial explanation, not attribution to both components.
A slower pooling cell despite lower explicit workspace supports launch/dispatch cost as a competing explanation and does not refute other workspace implementations.
alternative_explanations: Last-round global benefit may contain timing noise, cache/allocator variation or BF16 rounding; candidate diagnostics were not requested in existing receipts.
ID capacity losses may reflect optimizer/initialization/embedding conditioning, not a universal capacity requirement.
Direct-layout copy savings may be too small; kernel layout or implicit copies may offset them.
Pooling BMM uses a different FP32 summation order, may use backend scratch and can cost more launches than pointwise multiply/reduce. These are explicit implementation tradeoffs, not new information.
Same-seed retraining repeats are timing/reproducibility checks, not independent mechanism or seed-uncertainty contrasts; no new seed is authorized by this proposal.
